name: League of Light: Silent Mountain - Collector's Edition
storyline:
A member of the League of Light named Edward has vanished while on a mission in the remote mountain town of Stonecrown. The League sends you, one of its trusted detectives, to investigate his disappearance.

When you arrive, you find the town under a strange curse — stone statues have come to life, and the terrified townspeople whisper that Edward is responsible. The once peaceful Silent Mountain looms over the valley, shrouded in mist and mystery.

As you search for answers, you uncover that an ancient power lies within the mountain — a force capable of turning living beings to stone. Someone has awakened it, and its magic is spreading through the land. To save Stonecrown and clear Edward’s name, you must uncover the mountain’s secret, confront the source of the power, and reveal the truth behind Edward’s disappearance before darkness consumes everything.
summary: Solve the mysteries of Stoneville and escape with your life!
